incidents.name: SpaceGodzilla flash-loan price manipulation
incidents.notes: The SpaceGodzilla contract sized its BUSD payout from the manipulable pair reserves it read, so a 16-pool flash loan moved that price and let the attacker withdraw the contract's BUSD.

sources.ref: onchain review: SpaceGodzilla 0x2287c04a15bb11ad1358ba5702c1c95e2d13a5e0 created 2022-07-11T06:55:55Z by 0x69f937f3847faebe9617822c72c80e924d039fb7, unrelated to attack sender 0x00a62eb08868ec6feb23465f61aa963b89e57e57; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: 30,378.84 USDT left the victim contract and 25,378.76 USDT landed on the attacker EOA in the exploit transaction. Boundary row: the victim behaved as coded and the attacker moved the price it read.
